scope: Pure actual-source registry controls; no engine entry-point wiring or native physics qualification

rows.name: only three runtime entry points; no dispose-by-owner/token or global bypass
no guard fast path does not inspect poisoned batch input or operation
one lease protects exactly its copied object identities
two owners release independently on the same target
reverse owner release preserves first rejection until it releases
overlapping multi-target leases never release another owner
duplicate identities are deduplicated and repeated disposal is safe
changing original target list or descriptor after registration cannot retarget policy
descriptor getters and target element getter are each read exactly once
descriptor getter mutation of original target array cannot change already copied targets
target object property getters are never read or frozen
invalid targets  leave no partial registration
invalid targets [object Object] leave no partial registration
invalid targets null leave no partial registration
invalid targets undefined leave no partial registration
invalid targets  leave no partial registration
invalid targets  leave no partial registration
invalid targets 1 leave no partial registration
invalid targets () => {} leave no partial registration
invalid targets  leave no partial registration
invalid rejection null leaves no membership
invalid rejection undefined leaves no membership
invalid rejection [object Object] leaves no membership
invalid rejection [object Object] leaves no membership
invalid rejection [object Object] leaves no membership
invalid rejection [object Object] leaves no membership
invalid rejection [object Object] leaves no membership
throwing target getter undefined leaves no earlier target installed
throwing target getter null leaves no earlier target installed
throwing target getter 0 leaves no earlier target installed
throwing target getter  leaves no earlier target installed
throwing target getter Error: explicit getter failure leaves no earlier target installed
throwing rejection code leaves no membership and preserves existing owner
throwing rejection message leaves no membership and preserves existing owner
caught nested register in target getter aborts both registrations
caught nested register in code getter aborts both registrations
caught nested register in message getter aborts both registrations
caught release in registration getter preserves existing lease and aborts new owner
nested single admission in registration getter is rejected even on unguarded targets
nested batch admission in registration getter is rejected even on unguarded targets
lease is frozen with only a closure release capability, fake object cannot release
rejection callbacks are never installed or invoked
guarded operation rejects without coercing an arbitrary operation object
unguarded object fast path still works while another owner is registered
batch succeeds for unrelated copied targets and empty array
batch rejects any protected later member without running an operation callback
batch reads full target list before reporting a protected first member
batch later invalid member is rejected before membership result, without changing owners
batch later throwing getter is retained as original input error and leaves owners intact
caught nested register during batch copy aborts with no registry changes
caught nested release during batch copy aborts with no registry changes
caught nested single during batch copy aborts with no registry changes
caught nested batch during batch copy aborts with no registry changes
failure does not poison a later valid registration or batch admission
independent target leases can be released and re-registered without old lease authority
final release restores zero-guard fast path and no input objects gained properties
